speaker: john_heminges
text: The Shrew at two. You are not in it, Will. Wednesday you are. Thursday the comedy. Saturday the Shrew again. Not today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am gone when I have asked one thing. Field wants the comedy for Sunday. He will read it with the door shut. He will not come to hear it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Thursday the house has the comedy. The book stays in my hand through Thursday. Saturday, after you are done, you may take the licensed book. I want it again before the house asks.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Saturday, then. Under my cloak on Sunday. No foul papers.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is not a loss. Go home. Two of the clock is not your bell today.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The licensed book, if you take any. Do not tell me Kemp's lines while you are asking. I have his tally. I am not making a new one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was not going to. The king is at the lodging. He is not this afternoon's business.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Keep him there. We have a shrew to set, and I will not have a king in the margin.
